metrics.name: Legal Correctness
metrics.description: Measures whether the model arrived at the legally correct conclusion.

metrics.name: Factual Accuracy
metrics.description: Claim-level ratio of accurate factual claims to total factual claims made.

metrics.name: Legal Reasoning

rubric.1.0: Reasoning is legally and logically sound
rubric.0.25: Some relevant reasoning but largely flawed

metrics.description: 5-level granular scale measuring logical steps connecting facts to law.

metrics.name: Citation Accuracy
metrics.description: Measures whether cited provisions actually support the associated claims.

metrics.name: Citation Completeness
metrics.description: Measures whether key substantive legal assertions carry citations.

metrics.name: Current-Law Accuracy
metrics.description: Measures whether active 2024/2025 legislation was identified and applied.

metrics.name: Repealed-Law Detection
metrics.description: Kasai Signature Metric: Detects and rejects obsolete legislation.

metrics.name: Temporal Accuracy
metrics.description: Measures whether the correct law for the target date/tax year was applied.

metrics.name: Scenario Application
metrics.description: Measures ability to apply legal rules to complex multi-fact SME scenarios.

metrics.name: Abstention Quality
metrics.description: Measures appropriate refusal to answer underspecified or ambiguous queries.
